questions.q: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.solution: The Indian National Congress was established in 1885. Its first session took place in Bombay.

questions.q: Which of India's neighbouring country is known as the "Land of Thunder Dragon"?
questions.solution: Bhutan is called Druk Yul, commonly translated as the Land of the Thunder Dragon.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a Social Media Platform?
questions.solution: Facebook, Twitter and Instagram are social networking platforms. Google is the search service in this list.

questions.q: _________ uses images with malicious files in them, meant to help a hacker steal your account information or infect your computer.
questions.solution: The clue is a malicious image used as a lure. That method is image phishing; smishing uses text messages.

questions.q: What is the capital of Republic of Croatia ?
questions.solution: Zagreb is Croatia’s capital. Dubrovnik is another Croatian city.

questions.q: NOIDA comes under which district of Uttar Pradesh ?
questions.solution: NOIDA is in Gautam Buddha Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh.

questions.q: When is World Post Day celebrated?
questions.solution: World Post Day falls on 9 October, commemorating the establishment of the Universal Postal Union.

questions.q: Who heads the Union Ministry of Home Affairs as of June 2024 ?
questions.solution: For the date specified in the question, June 2024, the Union Home Minister was Amit Shah.

questions.q: Which of the following types of pollution is cultural (accelerated) eutrophication ?
questions.solution: Eutrophication is excess nutrient enrichment of water, often caused by fertiliser runoff and sewage.

questions.q: Who was the Governor of RBI during the demonetization in 1946?
questions.solution: C. D. Deshmukh was RBI Governor during the 1946 demonetisation. Urjit Patel belongs to the 2016 episode.

questions.q: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with the Directive Principles of State Policy?
questions.solution: Directive Principles of State Policy appear in Part IV, Articles 36–51. Fundamental Rights appear in Part III.

questions.q: The book 'A Life Misspent' was written by whom?
questions.solution: A Life Misspent is the English title associated with Nirala’s Kulli Bhat.

questions.q: The main reason for the blueness of the sky is _________.
options: the absorption of blue light due to the air
the scattering of sunlight by air molecules
questions.solution: Air molecules scatter shorter wavelengths of sunlight more strongly. This Rayleigh scattering makes the sky appear blue.

questions.q: Raman Subba Row, who passed away recently, was associated with which sport?
questions.solution: Raman Subba Row played cricket for England. The question refers to his death in 2024.

questions.q: When was the first ever National Agriculture Policy announced?
questions.solution: India’s National Agriculture Policy was announced in July 2000.

questions.q: The United Nations Commission on Human Rights was replaced with the United Nations Human Rights Council for the enforcement of international human rights law in the year _________.
questions.solution: The UN Human Rights Council replaced the Commission on Human Rights in 2006.

questions.q: The year 1985 was declared as the International Year of _________.
questions.solution: The United Nations designated 1985 as the International Youth Year.

questions.q: What is the full form of BRI?
questions.solution: BRI stands for Belt and Road Initiative.

questions.q: tries to trick specific individuals into jeopardizing the security of the organization they work for.
questions.solution: Spear phishing targets a particular person or organisation using a tailored deceptive message.

questions.q: What is the name of the longest river in Peninsular India?
questions.solution: The Godavari is the longest river in Peninsular India.

questions.q: What is the full form of NHRC?
questions.solution: NHRC expands to National Human Rights Commission.

questions.q: What is the primary cause of ocean acidification?
questions.solution: Dissolved carbon dioxide forms carbonic acid in seawater. Increased absorption therefore lowers ocean pH.

questions.q: Which Indian state is known for its unique 'Warli' paintings?
questions.solution: Warli painting is associated with Maharashtra’s Warli communities.

questions.q: "Chikankari" is a traditional embroidery style that originated in which city of Uttar Pradesh ?
questions.solution: Lucknow is especially associated with the traditional Chikankari embroidery style.

questions.q: Who wrote "The Scarlet Letter"?
questions.solution: Nathaniel Hawthorne wrote The Scarlet Letter, published in 1850.

questions.q: Who was chosen as the brand ambassador of GST?
questions.solution: Amitabh Bachchan was appointed to promote GST awareness in 2017.

questions.q: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) comes under which Ministry?
options: Ministry of Mirco, Small & Medium Enterprises
questions.solution: DGFT operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, through the Department of Commerce.

questions.q: Which social media platform has a feature called "Streaks" to encourage frequent communication between users ?
questions.solution: Snapchat uses streaks to record successive days of exchanges between users.

questions.q: The capital of the Pallava dynasty was located at
questions.solution: Kanchipuram was the principal capital of the Pallava dynasty.

questions.q: What does the Financial Stability Board (FSB) do?
options: It manages the foreign exchange reserves of its member countries.
It regulates interest rates for central banks worldwide.
It provides financial support to developing countries.
questions.solution: The Financial Stability Board coordinates work concerning global financial stability.
